content.value_statement: Teams can produce inconsistent Anthropic-branded artifacts when color and typography choices vary. This skill supplies a defined palette, font hierarchy, fallbacks, and styling rules.
actual_capabilities: Provides four main colors and three accent colors for precise visual styling.
Assigns Poppins to headings and Lora to body text.
Provides Arial and Georgia as fallback fonts.
Defines headings as text sized 24 points or larger.
Guides readable text colors based on the background.
Applies orange, blue, and green accents to non-text shapes.
limitations: Provides guidance only and includes no executable styling script or artifact template.
Exact typography requires Poppins and Lora to be installed.
Fallback fonts can change spacing and visual appearance.
Covers Anthropic styling and does not define other brand systems.

use_cases.title: Standardize Presentation Design
use_cases.description: Apply consistent colors, heading styles, body fonts, and shape accents across a slide deck.

use_cases.title: Review Marketing Artifacts
use_cases.description: Check documents and campaign visuals against the defined Anthropic palette and typography rules.

use_cases.title: Build Branded Documents
use_cases.description: Create readable reports with consistent hierarchy, approved colors, and reliable system font fallbacks.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Basic Styling
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the Anthropic brand guidelines to this presentation. Use the defined colors, heading fonts, body fonts, and readable fallbacks.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs consistent styling for an existing artifact.

prompt_templates.title: Review Brand Consistency
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this document for Anthropic brand consistency. List color, typography, hierarchy, and readability changes, then provide revised styling instructions.
prompt_templates.scenario: A team needs a focused visual quality review.

prompt_templates.title: Restyle a Slide Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Restyle this slide deck with the Anthropic palette. Use Poppins for headings, Lora for body text, and alternate accent colors across shapes.
prompt_templates.scenario: A designer needs detailed guidance for a complete presentation.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Artifact Remediation
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a detailed remediation plan for this artifact. Map every visual element to an approved color, font role, fallback, and contrast treatment.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user needs a complete styling specification before implementation.

output_examples.input: Style a title slide with a dark background and one accent shape.
output_examples.output: Use the dark main color as the background and the light main color for text. Set the heading in Poppins and use orange for the shape.

output_examples.input: Review a report that uses one font for every text element.
output_examples.output: Use Poppins for headings sized 24 points or larger. Use Lora for body text, with Arial and Georgia as respective fallbacks.

output_examples.input: Create a consistent accent plan for six presentation shapes.
output_examples.output: Cycle through orange, blue, and green twice. Keep text colors separate from shape accents and confirm readable contrast against every background.

best_practices: Confirm font availability before finalizing layouts.
Use the specified fallbacks when Poppins or Lora is unavailable.
Check text contrast after applying background and accent colors.
anti_patterns: Do not use accent colors as arbitrary replacements for every main color.
Do not apply Poppins to all body text.
Do not assume fallback fonts preserve identical spacing.

faq.question: Which fonts does this skill recommend?
faq.answer: It recommends Poppins for headings and Lora for body text.

faq.question: What happens when the preferred fonts are unavailable?
faq.answer: Use Arial for headings and Georgia for body text.

faq.question: Which text counts as a heading?
faq.answer: The guidance treats text sized 24 points or larger as a heading.

faq.question: Can this skill install fonts?
faq.answer: No. It uses installed fonts and provides fallback choices.

faq.question: Does this skill include an automated styling tool?
faq.answer: No. It provides design rules but includes no executable styling implementation.

faq.question: Which accent colors are available?
faq.answer: The accent palette includes orange, blue, and green.
